test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice with faces R, P, T, S, M and B are shown below. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23b1b5d38e67edd986db9b1103cf924d78ee20796161e38b3b527cac21862a1e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As S is common on both the dices, it is clear that R, T, P, and M are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. B will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2603ebaabd620fd031a3ec9f1ca5d06b68b0117fd46e2de3ada4401f0d696cf.png] 

Opposite pairs:

R → P

T → M

S → B

So, the opposite side of "S" will be side "B".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
